notes: Covers exactly phase-07 Steps 8-11 as scoped (Steps 5-7's UI confirmation-dialog widget test and the kill/cold-restart integration_test are explicitly out of scope for this pass, per the task). All production code (api_exceptions.dart's NotCurrentTaskException/ResponseWindowExpiredException, api_client.dart's submitAnswer() typed-409 remap, sync_engine.dart's ordered catch clauses and RateLimitBackoff integration, rate_limit_backoff.dart itself, media_upload_coordinator.dart's parallel RateLimitBackoff integration, and exam_attempt_bloc.dart's ForceSubmitRequested/SyncTaskRejectedExternally handlers) was read and independently verified against the phase file's Design Constraints and the task's own description before writing tests -- all matched exactly as described, with no discrepancies found. Key verification: the catch-clause ordering in SyncEngine._flushOne (`on NotCurrentTaskException` and `on ResponseWindowExpiredException` before the generic `on ConflictException`) is correct as written -- confirmed empirically via the taskRejectedExternally regression tests (the typed catches fire and emit on the stream; the generic ConflictException catch fires for ANSWER_ALREADY_SUBMITTED and does not emit), not merely assumed from the source order. Fake-clock testing: RateLimitBackoff's injectable `now` callback was used throughout (a mutable `currentTime` DateTime variable manually advanced between assertions) — no test relies on Future.delayed or a real wall-clock wait to exercise the cooldown window. Mocktail semantics note: verify(...).called(n) consumes/marks matched invocations (Mockito-style), so the Step 9/11 backoff tests are careful to either consume-then-verifyNever or accumulate counts consistently across sequential flush/upload passes within a single test -- this was caught and fixed mid-pass after an initial draft produced a false failure from double-counting assumptions, confirmed by empirically running the suite rather than assuming mocktail's verify-consumption behavior. Full `flutter test` across the whole repo passed: 158 tests total (140 pre-existing + 18 new), 0 failures, 0 skipped. `flutter analyze` reports zero warnings/errors (one info-level `prefer_final_locals` lint on the necessarily-mutable fake-clock `currentTime` variable in media_upload_coordinator_test.dart, which cannot be `final` since it is reassigned to advance the clock). No production code was modified -- only test files: test/unit/network/api_client_test.dart, test/unit/sync/sync_engine_test.dart, test/unit/sync/media_upload_coordinator_test.dart, and test/unit/features/exam_attempt/exam_attempt_bloc_test.dart, all edited in place (no new test files needed; existing sibling files already covered this phase's production files).
